design_policy.story_selection: One optional DRAFT story only for D04-PC01. PC02-PC04 remain candidates.

design_policy.npc_autonomy: No future agenda, presence, knowledge or initiative is authored; actor arrays remain empty until evidence and separate permission.
design_policy.epistemic_scope: C11 exists only as a derived archive account. It does not establish current condition, complete cause, adaptation author/date, culprit, intent, supernatural influence, completed repair, test or release.
design_policy.truth_lock: m201-report-authorship remains blocked for answer-dependent investigation, clues, suspects, motives, NPC knowledge/initiative or scenes until effective segregation is verified or an open variant is expressly approved.
design_policy.causality: No cross-thread causal link added; prior typed D04 relations retain their original classes.
design_policy.scene_authority: PREPARED is documentary only. No SCENE_READY, NARRATOR_PERMISSION, operational promotion, cycle write or event is granted.
design_policy.mechanics: No roll or result, XP, FV, power, relationship, asset, injury or mechanical consequence is authored; prior rolls are never repeated.
design_policy.tone: Human-scale accountability and uncertainty may carry personal horror only if later play establishes the pressure. No adversary, coercion, injury, supernatural cause or retaliation is presumed.

story_selection.rule: Only D04-elevated provisional PC01 receives a D08 story draft; PC02-PC04 remain candidates.
story_selection.actor_presence: No future agent/presence is established; scene actor arrays intentionally empty.

stories.inciting_incident: UNKNOWN. No present incident, request, deadline or current technical condition is established. The story can become eligible only if a later source establishes a current question and the player chooses it.
stories.why_now: UNKNOWN. No diegetic date or urgency is set. Calendar passage, the open-thread label and this publication do not activate the story.
goals: If chosen, distinguish the derived C11 record from current evidence and explicit unknowns.
Allow the player to set a bounded review scope or select a supported local disposition without requiring causal resolution.
Permit refusal, pause, abandonment, failure or an evidenced alternative without penalty or forced retry.
stories.nonmandatory_entry: No invitation, NPC request, work order, deadline or scene is presumed. Entry requires current cycle/pointer reconciliation, a current source establishing a live question, applicable authority, separate SCENE_READY and NARRATOR_PERMISSION, and the player choosing to participate. Decline or deferral carries no penalty.
stories.dramatic_question: Qual disposição, se alguma, pode ser sustentada por evidência e considerada segura pelas pessoas responsáveis, ou qual alternativa documentada preserva a segurança sem presumir resolução?
escalation: No current source or player opt-in: no scene; keep DRAFT.
If later records are incomplete or conflict, narrow claims to the supported record and preserve the conflict; suspend locally without adding danger.
Only if current evidence, actual authority and a player-selected scope exist may a local disposition be considered; no outcome or antagonist is assumed.
critical_choices: Participate, decline, defer or leave the question untouched.
If participating, choose what documented question to pursue or stop if evidence/authority is insufficient.
Accept only a supported disposition, choose a supported alternative, suspend, refuse or abandon; no choice closes unrelated threads.

closure_routes.condition: A future authorized assessment actually occurs; relevant evidence, authority and any required test/release are documented and persisted.
consequences: Record only the demonstrated local disposition; infer no complete cause, author, motive or linked-thread resolution.
closure_routes.closure_test: Evidence-backed local disposition, demonstrated authority where required, persisted event and successful readback; other threads remain open.

closure_routes.condition: A future review establishes only a bounded subset or ends with evidence/authority still missing.
consequences: Record the limited result and exact unknowns; missing evidence is not a failure.
closure_routes.closure_test: Close the local review as partial with remaining questions persisted/read back; no plot closure claimed.

closure_routes.condition: The player or evidenced responsible authority chooses an alternative supported by then-current sources.
consequences: Record only the selected authorized alternative and demonstrated effects; examples are not preselected.
closure_routes.closure_test: Alternative and authority are source-backed and locally persisted/read back.

closure_routes.condition: The player explicitly declines or withdraws from the optional focus.
consequences: No penalty or inferred motive; record refusal only if explicitly stated in play.
closure_routes.closure_test: End or do not enter; no character decision is fabricated and no condition is called resolved.

closure_routes.condition: A future authorized attempt actually fails or evidence does not support a safe disposition.
consequences: Preserve only the failed attempt and evidenced effects; infer no sabotage, culprit, supernatural cause or negligence; no forced retry.
closure_routes.closure_test: Record the actual failure/block and stop or suspend locally with uncertainty explicit.

closure_routes.condition: A later independently persisted authoritative event resolves the local question outside these prepared scenes.
consequences: Do not author the offscreen event; after it occurs, read back its source and record only supported content.
closure_routes.closure_test: Verify a real later event and authority; otherwise remain UNKNOWN.

consequences: This proposal changes no current narrative state.
A local disposition cannot close report-authorship, Pavel follow-up or another thread by association.
No consequence exists until an authorized future action actually causes and persists it.
stories.refusal_path: If the player declines, pauses, leaves or abandons the focus, stop without penalty or retrospective motive. Record only an explicit in-play choice and leave the question at its evidenced status.
stories.failure_path: If an authorized future attempt fails or evidence/authority is inadequate, stop or suspend the local attempt, preserve the record and unknowns, and do not add a culprit, cause, injury, retry or moral penalty.
